vibe_rationale: Tightly curated techno and house festival on Cockatoo Island with serious club credibility, though single-scene and promoter-run with premium partners.
fit_notes: Adult, committed techno and house crowd on an island site where water, shade and recovery matter, with precedent among non-endemic brands such as adidas and W Hotels. No partnerships contact is published, so the route is a direct approach to the promoter, Bizarro, and a single deal could cover its other city events the same weekend.
